FX-SHADOW-001.says: The defaults: black at 50 per cent, direction 135, distance 5, softness 0. The card's shadow falls down and to the right, 3.54 pixels each way, spread by the bilinear sample over the pixels it falls between; where it lies wholly under the card's shape it is black at half covering. The card itself, fully covered, is unchanged, and the shadow's lower part falls below the frame.

FX-SHADOW-002.says: Direction 0, distance 2: the shadow sits exactly two pixels above the card, black at half covering in rows 1 and 2; the soft pixel's shadow, at (10, 2), is half its covering of 128/255.

FX-SHADOW-003.says: Direction 90, distance 2: exactly two pixels right. The soft pixel, with the card's shadow behind it, takes the shadow through its uncovered share: its covering goes from 0.502 to 0.751, its colour unchanged, as the shadow is black.

FX-SHADOW-004.says: Direction 180, distance 2: exactly two pixels below, in rows 7 and 8, and the soft pixel's, at (10, 6), is half its covering.

FX-SHADOW-005.says: Direction 270, distance 2: exactly two pixels left, in columns 3 and 4.

FX-SHADOW-006.says: Direction -270 is a quarter turn clockwise from up, the same as 90: FX-SHADOW-003 exactly.

FX-SHADOW-007.says: Distance 0, softness 0: the shadow sits exactly behind the card, so it shows only through the soft pixel, whose covering goes from 0.502 to 0.627; nothing else changes and the layer does not grow.

FX-SHADOW-008.says: Distance 0, softness 5 (3 before D-774): the shadow, blurred at sigma 1, spreads three pixels out from the card on every side, darkest next to it and fading outward; column 1 and beyond stay empty.

FX-SHADOW-009.says: Softness 10 (6 before D-774) at the default direction and distance: the shadow is FX-SHADOW-001's, blurred at sigma 2, so its darkest pixel is lighter than half covering and it reaches further.

FX-SHADOW-010.says: Opacity 0: no shadow; the frame is the drawing, untouched, though the layer still grows.

FX-SHADOW-011.says: Colour #2040a0, opacity 100, distance 2: a blue shadow at full covering where it lies wholly under the card's shape, its straight colour exactly #2040a0.

FX-SHADOW-012.says: FX-SHADOW-011 with the colour written in capitals: the same.

FX-SHADOW-013.says: Direction 90, distance keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 4 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-SHADOW-007, frame 2 is FX-SHADOW-003, frame 4 is four pixels right.

FX-SHADOW-014.says: Distance 2, direction keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 180 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-SHADOW-002, frame 2, at 90, is FX-SHADOW-003, and frame 4 is FX-SHADOW-004.

FX-SHADOW-015.says: Opacity keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, eased past its end (132.5 at frame 2): frame 0 has no shadow; frame 2 is held at 100 and is frame 4.

FX-SHADOW-016.says: FX-SHADOW-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved, and the shadow's right end, which would fall in columns 16 and 17, is cut off by the frame's edge.

FX-SHADOW-017.says: Direction 0, distance 5: the shadow of the card's two lower rows shows in rows 0 and 1; the rest falls above the frame and is cut off, and row 2 stays empty.

FX-SHADOW-024.says: Shadow Only "on" at the defaults: the card is left out and the shadow alone is drawn, FX-SHADOW-001's shadow exactly, black at half covering wherever it lies wholly under the card's moved shape; in row 6, where the card was, the shadow's top edge shows part covered, and above it, where the card was, the frame is empty.

FX-SHADOW-025.says: Shadow Only "on", distance 0, softness 0: the shadow exactly where the card was, black at half the card's covering at every pixel; the soft pixel at (10, 4) is black at half of 128/255.

FX-SHADOW-026.says: Shadow Only "off" written in the file: FX-SHADOW-001 exactly, as a file without the word.

FX-SHADOW-027.says: Shadow Only "on", colour #2040a0, opacity 100, direction 90, distance 2, softness 5 (3 before D-774): the blue shadow alone, softened, two pixels right of the card's place.

FX-SHADOW-028.says: Shadow Only "on" with opacity 0: nothing at all, the frame is empty, though the layer still grows.

FX-SHADOW-018.says: Opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHADOW-019.says: Distance -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHADOW-020.says: Softness 501, above 500. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHADOW-021.says: Direction 3601, above 3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHADOW-022.says: A colour written "black". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHADOW-023.says: Opacity keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHADOW-029.says: Shadow Only written "On", the panel's name, not the word "on". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHADOW-030.says: Shadow Only written "yes". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
